processing.description: Server post-processing of the uploaded track: `none` without a track (or for a track uploaded before post-processing existed), `pending` until it has run, then `done`, or `too_large`/`invalid` when no data could be derived.

trackStartedAt.description: First GPS fix, once processed: the owner gets the whole track's, everyone else the first fix the shared track shows.

isOwner.description: Whether the caller owns the session.

east.description: Less than `west` when the box crosses 180°.

Bounds.description: The track's bounding box, null until processed. The owner gets the whole track's; everyone else the box of what the shared track shows (privacy zones cut out).

directionDeg.description: Mean direction the wind blows from, degrees true.

gustMps.description: Strongest hourly gust at 10 m, m/s.

SessionWind.description: Modelled wind from Open-Meteo for the session's time and area, fetched only while the session is public or unlisted. Null when not fetched or not available.

summary.description: The track v1 summary (docs/metrics.md). At most 64 KiB.

segmentId.description: Stable segment UUID. Start a new one at every recording break or leg boundary.

put.description: The body is the gzipped track v1 file (docs/formats.md), sent as `application/gzip` with no Content-Encoding, at most 8388608 bytes. PUT the session's metadata first, with the same `revision`. Repeating the upload replaces the file. The server then derives the session's bounds, track times and (for shared sessions) wind in the background; `processing` on the session reports progress.

get.description: The gzipped track v1 file as `application/gzip`. Visibility works as for the session. The owner gets the file as uploaded. Everyone else gets a shared copy: fixes inside the owner's privacy zones removed, a `privacyGap` event wherever the line must break, no heart rate, only start/stop/pause/resume/lap/tack/gybe events, and the shared summary.
